Getters answer (slot read + eth_call; commit reverts with AccessControl for a fresh address). Only permissionless reward-shaped entry point is FuelMessagePortalV3.relayMessage (whenNotPaused only): eth_call from fresh 0x1111...1111 with a real relay's calldata reverts 0xd0ebeb4b (AlreadyRelayed), not AccessControl. Everything else is role-gated: FuelChainState.commit is onlyRole(COMMITTER_ROLE); gateway finalizeWithdrawal is onlyFromPortal; deposit/depositETH/sendMetadata are user deposits; admin fns onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE/PAUSER_ROLE/SET_RATE_LIMITER_ROLE). relayMessage forwards the message amount to message.recipient and the gateway credits the decoded L2 recipient - there is no fee, bounty or reward field and no pot: the caller is never paid on Ethereum (relayer compensation, if any, is on Fuel L2 in FUEL).
